title: Homologous recombination deficiency in triple-negative breast cancer: Multi-scale transcriptomics reveals distinct tumor microenvironments and limitations in predicting immunotherapy response.
authors: Kang, Kai; Wu, Yijun; Han, Chang; Wang, Li; Wang, Zhile; Zhao, Ailin
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于多尺度转录组学分析三阴性乳腺癌HRD相关肿瘤微环境并构建免疫治疗预测模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于互作建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is the most aggressive subtype of breast cancer and has the highest proportion of homologous recombination deficiency (HRD). HRD has been considered a biomarker of response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), but the reality is more complicated. A comprehensive comparison of the tumor microenvironment (TME) in HRD and non-HRD TNBC samples may be helpful. METHODS: Datasets from single-cell, spatial, and bulk RNA-sequencing were collected to explore the role of HRD in the development of TME at multiple scales. Based on the findings in the TME, machine learning algorithms were used to construct a response prediction model in eleven ICI therapy cohorts. RESULTS: A more exhausted phenotype of T cells and a more tolerogenic phenotype of dendritic cells were found in the non-HRD group. HRD reprograms the predominant phenotype of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) from myofibroblastic CAFs to inflammatory-like CAFs. As interactions between myofibroblastic CAFs and other cells, DPP4-chemokines associated with reduced immune cell recruitment were unique in the non-HRD group. The prediction model based on DPP4-related genes had acceptable performance in predicting response, prognosis, and immune cell content. Higher HRD scores in bulk RNA-sequencing samples indicated more activated immune cell function, but not higher immune cell content, which may be affected by factors such as antigen-presenting capacity. CONCLUSIONS: Based on multi-scale transcriptomics, our findings comprehensively reveal differences in the TME between HRD and non-HRD samples. Combining HRD with the prediction model or other methods for assessing immune cell content, may better predict response to ICIs in TNBC.
abstract_zh: 背景：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是最具侵袭性的乳腺癌亚型，且具有最高比例的同源重组缺陷（HRD）。HRD 一直被视为免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）反应的生物标志物，但实际情况更为复杂。对 HRD 和非 HRD TNBC 样本中肿瘤微环境（TME）进行全面比较可能有所帮助。方法：收集来自单细胞、空间和批量 RNA 测序的数据集，以在多尺度上探索 HRD 在 TME 发展中的作用。基于 TME 中的发现，使用机器学习算法在十一个 ICI 治疗队列中构建反应预测模型。结果：在非 HRD 组中发现了更耗竭的 T 细胞表型和更耐受性的树突状细胞表型。HRD 将癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）的主要表型从肌成纤维细胞样 CAFs 重编程为炎症样 CAFs。在肌成纤维细胞样 CAFs 与其他细胞的相互作用中，与免疫细胞募集减少相关的 DPP4-趋化因子在非 HRD 组中具有独特性。基于 DPP4 相关基因的预测模型在预测反应、预后和免疫细胞含量方面表现出可接受的性能。批量 RNA 测序样本中较高的 HRD 评分表明免疫细胞功能更活跃，但并非免疫细胞含量更高，这可能受抗原呈递能力等因素影响。结论：基于多尺度转录组学，我们的发现全面揭示了 HRD 和非 HRD 样本之间 TME 的差异。将 HRD 与预测模型或其他评估免疫细胞含量的方法相结合，可能更好地预测 TNBC 对 ICIs 的反应。
